title: Nanoporous silica · overlapping Si/O atoms · preparation
parts: One connected nanoporous Si/O sphere candidate: 72,500 atoms, full core retained
material: Blue Bambu PLA Basic primary; Bambu PVA support body and interface secondary. Live mapping to be rechecked after relocation.

source.evidence: Source atomic coordinates: camilla.data SHA256 69e8be921c019d3a860cbf05067aab95129832255816b00fe27282c99de3ba9e. Type identities Si/O/H are inferred from coordination and distances; source provides no element names, bond topology or molecule labels. Selection retains every Si and O within 2.0 Å of any Si using the periodic cell, and removes all H and other O. The H-free selected coordinates SHA256 is 5145761db4e8b85c4e8ad76757913dd47a3448c73c3abc7b2e9c7bfce3e48a97.

notes: The80mm full native slice completed successfully. Its actual slicer estimates are65.53gPLA,204.59gPVA and1d23h47m31s. Material-role, embeddedG-code checksum and deposited-bounds audits passed; five actual internal support and weak-neck windows were inspected, with partial modeled bead coverage at the weakest contacts and physical joining still unverified. This is a substantial reduction from the completed100mm baseline (113.09gPLA,603.60gPVA,4d13h26m10s), but misses theOctober26 target and is8.59g above the196g PVA planning allowance with20% reserve. Fresh remaining PVA was estimated at245g from49% of a500g roll using the official client calculation; this is not a weighed amount. A76mm uniform derivative is now being sliced to provide reserve margin, preserving all72,500 selected main-component atoms, the full core and original radius ratio;882 boundary-fragment exclusions remain recorded. Six native diagnostic coupon comparisons established contour-following snug supports with a dense top interface as the better material/contact tradeoff; the complete80mm artifact now provides actual whole-model estimates. No file has been uploaded or printed. Automatic start remains held while the user arranges printer relocation, and fresh device, material, camera and exact-file gates are required afterwards. No physical strength, dryness, successful print or PVA-removal claim.
